# Aeries: Portals - Irvine Unified School District

> The Aeries Parent/Student Portal for Irvine Unified School District provides secure access to student records, grades, schedules, and account management.

My.iusd.org is the official portal login system for IUSD families, powered by Aeries student information management software. It enables parents and students to view academic progress, class schedules, and generate reports for the 2025-2026 school year.

## Key Topics

- Aeries Parent/Student Portal
- Irvine Unified School District (IUSD)
- Student login
- Parent portal
- Password reset
- Account recovery
- Class schedules
- Report viewer
- Email verification
- Account access
- School year 2025-2026
- Report generation
- Processing status

## Portal Access & Login

- [Aeries: Portals](https://my.iusd.org/): Main login portal for Irvine Unified School District students and parents to access Aeries accounts

## Account Management & Support

- [Lost Password for Aeries Parent/Student Portal Account](https://my.iusd.org/LostPassword.aspx): Password recovery and account access assistance for Aeries Parent/Student Portal users

## Reports & Data

- [View Report](https://my.iusd.org/ViewReport.aspx?t=self): Self-service report viewer and generation tool for accessing student records and academic information
